packageRules.description: A new major version of a Go module is a new module path, so it only becomes a requirement when a direct dependency imports it. Mockery is excluded because go.mod marks the tool as indirect.

docker/compose builds only against the compose-go version it requires. compose-go changes its Go API in minor releases, as v2.16 did when it moved service fields into an embedded ContainerSpec. Do not update compose-go on its own. A docker/compose update raises it through go get when that release requires a newer compose-go.
